/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja.name: Ash Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja.description: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |label1|% increased damage and last |label2|% longer.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.name: Atlas Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.description: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.name: Banshee Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.description: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.name: Baruuk Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.description: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.name: Caliban Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.description: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.name: Chroma Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.description: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.name: Citrine Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.description: Citrine grants nearby allies |BASE| health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by |HPS|, up to a maximum of |MAX|.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.name: Cyte-09 Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.description: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by |INCREASE|% up to |CAP|% for the duration of the current mission.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.name: Dagath Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.description: There is a |PERCENT|% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be |ENERGY|% more effective on Dagath.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.name: Dante Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.description: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.name: Ember Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.description: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.name: Equinox Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.description: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur.name: Excalibur Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur.description: Excalibur deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb.name: Excalibur Umbra Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb.description: Umbra exhibits sentience in combat without Transference control. Attacks |SPEED|% faster and deals |DAMAGE|% more damage while wielding swords.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot.name: Follie Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot.description: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by |SLOW|% for a few seconds. Afflicted enemies have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.name: Frost Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.description: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.name: Gara Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.description: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.name: Garuda Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.description:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.name: Gauss Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.description: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.name: Grendel Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.description: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre.name: Gyre Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre.description: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest.name: Harrow Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest.description:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.name: Hildryn Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.description: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate.name: Hydroid Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate.description: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman.name: Inaros Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman.description: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.name: Jade Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.description: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by |CHANCE|% for |DURATION|s.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.name: Khora Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.description: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.name: Koumei Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.description: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.

/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.name: Kullervo Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.description: Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.name: Lavos Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.description:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.name: Limbo Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.description: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki.name: Loki Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki.description: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.name: Mag Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.description: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl.name: Mesa Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl.description: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin.name: Mirage Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin.description: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro.name: Nekros Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro.description: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.name: Nidus Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.description: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko.name: Nokko Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko.description: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.

/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti.name: Nova Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti.description: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade.name: Nyx Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade.description: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin.name: Oberon Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin.description: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard.name: Octavia Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard.description: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia.name: Oraxia Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia.description: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk.name: Protea Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk.description: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.

/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete.name: Qorvex Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete.description: Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant.name: Revenant Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant.description: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino.name: Rhino Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino.description: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn.name: Saryn Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn.description: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith.name: Sevagoth Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith.description: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite.name: Styanax Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite.description: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Temple/Temple.name: Temple Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Temple/Temple.description: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy.name: Titania Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy.description: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Trinity.name: Trinity Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Trinity.description: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.

/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.name: Uriel Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.description:
Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)

GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)

VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.name: Valkyr Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.description: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper.name: Vauban Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper.description: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt.name: Volt Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt.description: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.name: Voruna Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.description: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.name: Wisp Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.description: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.name: Wukong Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.description: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram.name: Xaku Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram.description: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli.name: Yareli Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli.description: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Tengu.name: Zephyr Passive
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Tengu.description: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
